name: Luxury Commercial
core_identity: A premium advertising film still that looks expensive, sleek and aspirational. Everything is polished, dark and elegant, with light gliding over fine materials. Gold details, glossy highlights and deep black backgrounds make it recognizable.
medium: Premium advertising film still, shot on a cinema camera in a controlled studio or a luxurious interior.
lighting: Soft glossy highlights, bright rim light that traces edges, controlled reflections and dark elegant backgrounds. Light falls in narrow soft strips on glass, silk and gold, and warm accent lamps add a golden glow. Contrast is high but smooth.
color_palette: Black, gold, deep navy, champagne and marble white. Colours are rich, controlled and dark, with warm gold highlights and no bright cheap colours. Skin is warm and polished.
camera: A smooth cinema look with 50 mm to 100 mm lenses, shallow depth of field, macro details of materials and slightly low angles. Reflections and bokeh highlights are soft and round. Clean centred or rule-of-thirds framing.
composition: Elegant, uncluttered scenes with one hero subject, symmetrical or carefully balanced layouts, and rich dark negative space. Reflective surfaces such as marble, glass and polished wood, with gold accents in the frame.
texture: Polished surfaces, glass, silk, satin, marble veining, velvet and fine gold details, all clean and flawless. Highlights are sharp and crisp, with a fine fabric weave and no grain.
characters: Elegant, refined, well-dressed people with polished grooming, tailored dark suits or evening wear, subtle jewellery and calm composed expressions. Skin is smooth but natural, and hair is neat. Older people appear distinguished, with silver hair and a straight posture.
negative: brand names, brand logos, cheap look, cluttered scene, flat lighting, bright garish colors, casual snapshot, cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, 3D render, CGI look, low resolution, text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, extra fingers, distorted hands, deformed face, duplicate people, blurry
motion_rules: Slow gliding camera moves along the surface, slow-motion details such as tea pouring or silk moving, and light sweeps that pass across gold and glass. Subjects move slowly and with poise. No fast cuts, no shake and no sudden zooms.
